title: SmartHull fixed-stop repeat tests
setup: 2 mm polycarbonate plate, span 228.6 mm, central load against fixed stops, dark room, drive 132/255 on D25, sensing D35 / reference D34
excluded: The unreliable third press at the 18.5 mm and 28.5 mm stops was excluded, as reported by the operator.
limits: Strain is calculated from deflection, not measured with a strain gauge
